context: Equipment rental. Acquired by Herc Holdings in 2025, so FY2024 is the last 10-K. Treat this as a screen dated February 2025.

manual.cite: Cash-flow statement (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1339605/000095017025024867/R7.htm): Depreciation and amortization of property and equipment 47,982 + Depreciation of rental equipment 375,330 + Amortization of intangible assets 10,265 + Amortization of finance lease ROU assets 445.

depreciationAmortization.note: Excludes amortization of deferred financing costs (1,400), which is interest. XBRL companyfacts carries only the $48.0M line.

manual.cite: Balance sheet (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1339605/000095017025024867/R2.htm): Senior secured credit facility 199,304 + Senior unsecured notes 1,244,295 + Finance lease liabilities 4,007.

totalDebt.note: Senior notes are shown net of discount and deferred financing costs.

manual.cite: Leases note (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1339605/000095017025024867/R73.htm): finance lease payments due 2025, 622 (undiscounted). Balance sheet (R2) shows no current portion of the credit facility or notes.

totalCapex.note: Non-rental PP&E only. Rental fleet purchases are a separate cash-flow line.

manual.cite: 10-K Item 1: "Founded in 1961 through our predecessor companies, we have been in the equipment services business for approximately 63 years."

depreciation.note: PP&E plus rental fleet depreciation. Maintenance capex proxy.

manual.cite: Cash-flow statement (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1339605/000095017025024867/R7.htm): Purchases of rental equipment (344,642).
